simbadQuery: select top 180 main_id, ra, dec, plx_value, pmra, pmdec, rvz_radvel, sp_type, otype, coo_bibcode, plx_bibcode, pm_bibcode, rvz_bibcode, sp_bibcode from basic where plx_value >= 100 and otype in ('PM*','BY*','LM*','Em*','WD*','SB*','**','V*','BD*','*') order by plx_value desc
archiveQuery: select pl_name, hostname, discoverymethod, disc_year, pl_orbper, pl_orbsmax, pl_bmasse, pl_bmassprov, pl_rade, pl_eqt, sy_dist, pl_controv_flag, pl_bmasse_reflink, pl_rade_reflink, pl_orbper_reflink, pl_orbsmax_reflink from pscomppars where hostname in ('Barnard''s star','eps Eri','GJ 887','Ross 128','tau Cet','Teegarden''s Star','GJ 876','GJ 273','YZ Cet') order by hostname, pl_orbper
deduplication: Explicit source-id curation: exclude aggregate aliases wherever selected physical A/B components exist; one source anchor for unresolved systems; companions share systemId and renderAtLocalScale=false.
